predecessors.name: Sena dynasty
predecessors.text: the Deva kingdom of Damodaradeva: the Chittagong division (Comilla, Noakhali, Chittagong)

successors.name: Balbani sultanate of Bengal
successors.text: the Bikrampur-Sonargaon-Dhaka country the Devas held at the end

ledger.x: 1230: the Devas rule the Comilla-Noakhali-Chittagong country as the Sena kingdom ends.
1280 (bridge): the Devas hold Bikrampur, Sonargaon and Dhaka.
1294 (last record): the Deva kingdom's story stops.

wars.name: Balban's Bengal campaign of 1281 (Deva alliance)
wars.outcome: The Deva king 'made an alliance with Ghiyas-ud-Din Balban in 1281'; no land changed hands on the Deva page.

certainty.note: The page gives only Bikrampur and a regional extent; the Chittagong division, and from 1280 a 40 km disc round Dhaka, are the researcher's reading.
